name: Export detected Instagram follower or following changes to CSV with Instoryview

parameters.content:
## Export Instagram change history to CSV
[Instoryview](https://instoryview.com) stores changes for accounts you track.

### How it works
Choose followers or following and an inclusive date range. This workflow reads retained history, follows every cursor, and produces a CSV plus a JSON summary. An empty result creates a header-only CSV. Times show when changes were detected, not when someone acted on Instagram.

### Setup
1. Track an account in Instoryview and let history accumulate.
2. Create a **data:read** API key in [Developer settings](https://instoryview.com/settings/developers).
3. In **Read all change pages**, create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
4. Edit **Export settings**. Defaults cover seven UTC days.
5. Execute the workflow. Download the file from the CSV branch and inspect **Export summary**.

See the [changes API guide](https://instoryview.com/docs/changes). Reads use zero new collection credits. Instoryview access and tracking history are required. The export stops on errors or beyond 100 pages; reduce the date range and rerun. The changes cursor context expires after 15 minutes; start again if it expires.

### 1. Choose your export
Set a tracked username, followers or following, dates, and timezone. Dates are inclusive and limited to 366 days. Settings are validated before the request.

### 2. Read stored history
Select a Header Auth credential. Cursor pages wait 1.5 seconds, with a 100-page ceiling. HTTP errors stop execution. For 401/403 check the key and data:read access; for 429 wait and rerun. Missing history needs existing tracking, never an automatic paid lookup.

### 3. Download and review
Inspect summary coverage and warnings. Counts come from the first page, not page totals. Download CSV from the populated or empty branch. Spreadsheet formulas are escaped; import ID columns as Text to preserve long IDs.

pagination.nextURL: ={{ (() => { const meta = $response.body?.meta; const base = $('Validate settings').first().json.changesUrl; if (meta?.hasMore === false) return base; if (meta?.hasMore !== true || typeof meta.nextCursor !== 'string' || !meta.nextCursor) throw new Error('Instoryview pagination requires hasMore and nextCursor.'); return base + '?limit=100&cursor=' + encodeURIComponent(meta.nextCursor); })() }}
pagination.completeExpression: ={{ (() => { const meta = $response.body?.meta; if (!meta || typeof meta.hasMore !== 'boolean') throw new Error('Invalid Instoryview pagination metadata.'); if (meta.hasMore && (typeof meta.nextCursor !== 'string' || !meta.nextCursor)) throw new Error('Instoryview returned hasMore without nextCursor.'); return meta.hasMore === false; })() }}
